topic: Asking the Tutor for Extra Help

script.title: EXTRA MATH HELP
script.story_hook: A student asks her tutor for extra help with fractions.
script.intro_zh: 一位學生請家教老師多幫她補分數。
script.welcome_en: Welcome back, my friends! Today a student is asking her tutor for extra help.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎回來，我的朋友們！今天是一位學生向家教老師請求額外的幫忙。
script.outro: That's the whole plan for Thursday. Math feels friendlier now.
script.outro_zh: 週四的安排就這樣定了。數學看起來友善多了。
script.practice_intro_en: Repeat each sentence after I say it.
script.practice_intro_zh: 我說一句，你跟著重複一句。
script.char_a_description: a shy teenage girl of sixteen with straight dark hair tied in a high ponytail, wearing a striped hoodie and white sneakers, hugging a spiral math notebook
script.char_b_description: an easygoing college-age man in his early twenties with buzz-cut black hair and round wire glasses, wearing an open flannel shirt over a plain gray tee, twirling a pencil
script.youtube_title: 【📚課外輔導英文】「這卡住很多小孩」怎麼說？🗓️約加課、問時間、帶作業全都會｜🎧A2 聽力練習｜Tutor English
script.youtube_title_en: “That Trips a Lot of Kids Up” — Asking the Tutor for Extra Help
script.youtube_description:

Stuck on fractions but too shy to ask for more help? This real student-and-tutor conversation shows you how. You'll learn to describe what confuses you, book an extra session, and bring homework to sort out together. 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA, plus a listen-and-repeat section that makes every phrase stick.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】📚請託輔導英文｜描述卡關・另約時段・帶作業請益｜聽完就會約加課｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
分數越學越迷糊，卻不敢跟老師說？
要怎麼開口約一堂額外的課？

這一集帶大家走進放學後的輔導教室，跟著一位高一年級的學生從描述卡關的地方、約週四加課，到決定用畫披薩的方式學分數，全程都用自然的美式英語。

你會聽到：
✏️ 描述卡關：例如「fractions really confuse me lately」、「adding fractions with different bottoms.」。
🗓️ 約加課時間：例如「Could you come Thursday extra?」、「Three thirty, right after our usual session.」。
📕 約功課與通知：例如「Bring your homework too」、「So she knows you'll be later.」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次卡關，別再低頭不說話，開口問就對了！
script.thumbnail_action: showing an open notebook full of fractions
script.title_quote: That trips a lot of kids up

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, do you have a minute?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuːz mi du ju hæv ə ˈmɪnət/
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，你有幾分鐘嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure! What's going on with math?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, fractions really confuse me lately.
dialogue.zh: 呃，最近分數真的把我搞糊塗了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, adding fractions with different bottoms.
dialogue.zh: 就是分母不同的分數要相加。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, that trips a lot of kids up.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ ðæt trɪps ə lɑt ʌv kɪdz ʌp/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Really? I thought I was just slow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈrɪəli aɪ θɔt aɪ wʌz dʒʌst sloʊ/
dialogue.zh: 真的嗎？我還以為是我太遲鈍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No way. Could you come Thursday extra?
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ weɪ kʊd ju kʌm ˈθɜrzdeɪ ˈɛkstrə/
dialogue.zh: 才不會。你週四能多來一堂課嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes! What time works for you?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three thirty, right after our usual session.
dialogue.phonetic: /θri ˈθɜrti raɪt ˈæftər ˈaʊər ˈjuːʒəl ˈsɛʃən/
dialogue.zh: 三點半，就在平常那堂課之後。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we use pizza pictures? Like slices?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi juːz ˈpiːtsə ˈpɪktʃərz laɪk ˈslaɪsɪz/
dialogue.zh: 我們可以用披薩圖嗎？就是一塊一塊的那種？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We'll draw circles like pizza, trust me.
dialogue.phonetic: /wil drɔ ˈsɜrkəlz laɪk ˈpiːtsə trʌst mi/
dialogue.zh: 我們就把圓畫成披薩，信我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That sounds way better than the textbook.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt saʊndz weɪ ˈbɛtər ðæn ðə ˈtɛksˌtbʊk/
dialogue.zh: 這聽起來比課本好太多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring your homework too, and we'll sort it.
dialogue.phonetic: /brɪŋ jɔr ˈhoʊmˌwɜrk tu ænd wil sɔrt ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 也把作業帶來，我們一起處理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I tell my mom about Thursday?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ tɛl maɪ mʌm əˈbaʊt ˈθɜrzdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 週四這件事，我要跟媽媽說嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, so she knows you'll be later.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs soʊ ʃi noʊz jul bi ˈleɪtər/
dialogue.zh: 要，讓她知道你會晚一點回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will. Thanks a bunch, seriously.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime! Thursday, three thirty. See you there.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛniˌtaɪm ˈθɜrzdeɪ θri ˈθɜrti si ju ðɛr/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣！週四三點半，到時見。
